title: neomammillaria polygona
intro: Neomammillaria polygona, commonly known as Mammillaria polygona, is a species of cactus that belongs to the family Cactaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Neomammillaria polygona include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
